oldValue: Special vows operate like the clerical ceremony, but do not work on paladins and do work on cavaliers of any alignment. Hallowed ground protects a druid’s permanent grove from disease and other natural disasters for as long as the druid maintains it as a permanent base.
newValue: Special vows operate like the clerical ceremony, but do not work on paladins and do work on cavaliers of any alignment. Hallowed ground is cast on the druid’s permanent grove, ensorcelling its trees against disease and other natural disasters. The ground remains hallowed while the druid maintains that grove as a permanent base.
meaning: The protected subjects are the grove trees; the ground remains hallowed while maintained as a permanent base. The special-vows prefix and printed rank/performer anomaly remain unchanged.
